name: VNX British Pound
oneLiner: VGBP is VNX's Liechtenstein-licensed pound sterling stablecoin redeemable 1:1, backed by GBP cash in Swiss and Liechtenstein bank accounts.
collateral: GBP deposits held in bank accounts in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, confirmed 1:1 by Areva General Auditing and Trust Company Limited (December 2024)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through VNX Commodities AG; tokens minted on demand for verified customers depositing equivalent GBP value

mintAuthority.summary: VGBP uses VNX's RBAC architecture on Base. VNXCToken impl with rbacManager = 0xb6622a9...b60ee (Base VNXManager, owner = EOA 0xD63052...051F). EOA confirmed as sole minter: 80 of 80 recent mint() calls on Base originate from that EOA.

controls.label: VGBP VNXCToken proxy (Base)
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200982, EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x0d12d751e71dec6bfed7f5ac34b1fb8df4782ab1 (VNXCToken). VNXCToken source: mint() gated by onlyMinters → isMinter() = rbacManager.hasRole(caller, minterRoleId). 80 of 80 recent mint() calls (selector 0x40c10f19) confirmed successful exclusively from EOA 0xD63052E09AF164CEF57695D3b96043EA848B051F.

controls.label: VGBP Base VNXManager RBAC contract
controls.evidence: Identified from VGBP proxy deployment calldata as the _rbac parameter passed to VNXCToken.initialize(). eth_getCode confirms this is a contract. owner() = 0xD63052E09AF164CEF57695D3b96043EA848B051F (the VNX minting EOA, confirmed EOA via eth_getCode empty at Base block 47200982).

controls.label: VGBP owner/minter EOA (Base)
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200982, owner() on VGBP proxy returns this address; eth_getCode returns empty (confirmed EOA). Sole minter: 80 of 80 recent mint() calls confirmed from this EOA. Also owns the Base VNXManager RBAC contract. Issuer-context EOA; off-chain MPC/HSM indistinguishable on-chain, does not block verified.

controls.label: VGBP proxy admin contract
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 admin slot confirmed this address as proxy admin. owner() returns the same VNX EOA 0xD63052...051F. Upgrade path is thus also solely controlled by the issuer EOA.

review.evidence: At Base block 47200982: owner() confirmed = EOA 0xD63052...051F (eth_getCode empty); rbacManager = Base VNXManager 0xb6622a9...b60ee (contract, owner = same EOA); 80/80 recent mint() calls exclusively from that EOA. Proxy admin also owned by same EOA. All addressable mint-capable surfaces verified.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VGBP has issuer-controlled deployments across its listed chains, and the reviewed mint-authority data resolves direct VNX issuer minting on Base. No separate bridge, lockbox, or liquidity route was resolved, so Pharos treats current route risk as native issuance on supported chains.
